Ana (CS): Heads-up — Fjord QBR scheduled for Tue 10am PT. Need a concise cost+token econ snapshot and onboarding status before EOD Mon. cc @Mike - FinOps @Sylvia (SE)

Mike - FinOps: On it. Quick ask — do we want just last 30d or rolling 90d for the QBR charts?

Ana (CS): Last 30d for spike visibility, 90d for trend. Put both but highlight the last 30d.

Sylvia (SE): I'll confirm integration progress and open items from enablement. Primary blocker was the SAML callback — should be resolved. I'll post status shortly.

Jorge (CSM): Also capture whether they hit the embedding throttle we set last week — client called it out during onboarding.

billing-bot: ALERT: fjord-123 crossed 75% of monthly committed tokens threshold yesterday. Details: https://billing.redwood.example/customers/fjord-123/usage

Mike - FinOps: Draft numbers (pre-verify): last 30d tokens = 41,800,000; est monthly burn = 46M; projected overage if no throttle = ~5.2M tokens -> est $1,140 overcommit (using current unit rates).

Mike - FinOps: Query I ran:```sql
-- token usage by day
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE customer_id = 'fjord-123' AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day;
```

Ana (CS): Perfect. Can you also generate a simple chart and a 1-slide callout: "Top 3 drivers of token increase"? I'll add operational notes.

Sylvia (SE): Integration update: connectors 95% done, SAML fix deployed to staging, last-mile test with sample dataset succeeding. Remaining: permission mapping for 2 users, ETA Mon 3pm PT.

Jorge (CSM): I'll ask the customer to delay heavy ingestion until after the 10am maintenance window tomorrow — reduces chance of overage during QBR prep.

Mike - FinOps: Action items I'll do before EOD Mon: 1) finalize 30/90d charts 2) compute cost delta between quantized model variant and current model 3) create 80/90% quota alerts for them.

Ana (CS): For (2) please use the "q2-small-quant" config and include latency delta. We need to show cost vs perf tradeoff.

Mike - FinOps: Noted. Quick estimate: switching to q2-small-quant could cut token CPU cost ~18% but adds ~6-8ms median latency per request (depends on sequence length). I'll include sample numbers.

Sylvia (SE): I'll validate model compatibility with their prompt templates. If any structured output parsing breaks we should call it out as a risk.

Jorge (CSM): Customer feedback to capture for QBR: 1) embed recall in dev env 2) better observability on per-route token breakdown 3) request for monthly commit increase proposal. I'll capture quotes in the deck.

Ana (CS): Nice. Final checklist for owner assignment: - Charts + cost delta (Mike) - Integration + test notes (Sylvia) - Customer quotes + ask (Jorge) - Draft slide deck + runbook for next steps (Ana)

Mike - FinOps: I'll push charts to /drive/fjord-qbr and add CSV.

Sylvia (SE): I'll post a short test log and confirm the permission mapping status later today.

Jorge (CSM): Ping me when quota alerts are created so I can coordinate the customer notification.

Ana (CS): Great. If anyone hits blockers, DM me. Otherwise we'll reconvene Mon 5pm PT for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
